source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.1「回転翼航空機（マルチローター）」(1)4)機体の動き

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: マルチローターの基本操縦用語と機体運動の対応を正しく理解する。
evidence.tested_misconception: fixed-wing用語との混同などによりcontrol termとmovementを取り違える。
evidence.reasoning_path: control term -> movement axis -> map four commands

collision.note: LOW。Q004は指令伝達経路、Q062は右移動のローター制御であり、操縦用語mappingは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.1 explicitly maps throttle/rudder/aileron/elevator to multirotor movement. Existing items test actuator flow or one lateral movement, not the complete command mapping.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
